decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development would result in the loss of a small single-family dwelling house, suited to this use, and for which there is a continuing need in the Borough.  It is therefore, contrary to policy H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to Flats) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development would provide inadequate accommodation for the residents of the flats due to the unsatisfactory layout, un-neighbourly stacking of rooms, and flat B, as shown on the submitted drawing, not having access to private garden space.  It is therefore, contrary to policy H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to Flats) of  the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance for Private Amenity Space and Internal Space Provision.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development would result in the over-intensification of the use of the site which would result in an increase in activity which would be harmful to neighbouring residents living conditions by general disturbance. It is therefore, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), and H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to Flats) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development would provide in insufficient off street parking for the residents of the flats, in relation with the standards adopted by the Local Planning Authority, therefore giving rise to an increase in the demand for on street parking, interfering with the free flow and safety of traffic in the vicinity. It is therefore, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to Flats), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), and T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hard standings) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Conversion of existing single family house into 1 x two bed flat, 1 x  one bed flat, and 1 x  two bed flat.
